name: inception-analytics
description: Inception market positioning, flows, factor attribution and conditional scenarios.

interface.longDescription: Inception Analytics provides authorized Inception users with market positioning and flow analytics, Factor Lens attribution, conditional scenarios and native market views. It also explains supported Inception methods. Availability follows each user's permissions and data coverage. Prepared analysis can be displayed in saved, owner-scoped responses; users can export saved native views as PNG and explicitly retain supported datasets. An explicitly authorized support action can send a concise gap report to Inception support. Outputs are informational, conditional scenarios are not unconditional forecasts or price probabilities, and the plugin does not execute trades or analyze uploaded client portfolios.
defaultPrompt: Show the current market overview for Brent, WTI, gold, and corn.
Analyze the latest one-month factor contribution to return for Brent.
Which MoneyFlow fields are available for positioning and flow analysis?

publication.release_notes: Clarifies analytical preparation and saved-response behavior, supplies current review cases, and qualifies reviewer access and native display compatibility. No trade execution is supported.
